# Squeeze AI — Enterprise Local Context Compression Layer

> Squeeze AI compresses raw JSON logs, source code ASTs, and developer prompts 100% locally on your computer before sending to LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini), unlocking up to 99% context headroom.

## Core Features
- **100% Local Privacy**: Runs entirely on your device. Zero data leaves your computer.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Native stdio & HTTP/SSE MCP server exposing `squeeze_compress`, `squeeze_retrieve`, `squeeze_stats`, `squeeze_doctor`.
- **Zero-Friction Auto Setup**: One command auto-configures Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf (`npx -y squeeze-ai mcp setup`).
- **AST Code & JSON Compression**: Shrinks repeated JSON keys and boilerplate code by 60–95%.

## Quickstart & Installation
```bash
# Global CLI Installation
npm install -g squeeze-ai

# Auto-Configure MCP Server for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor & Windsurf
npx -y squeeze-ai mcp setup

# Start Local Proxy Server
squeeze deploy

# Run Stdio MCP Server
squeeze mcp
```

## Available MCP Tools
- `squeeze_compress`: Compress large JSON logs, source code, API responses, or text before sending to LLM context.
- `squeeze_retrieve`: Retrieve original uncompressed context by reference ID (`sq_ref_...`) from local CCR memory.
- `squeeze_stats`: Get real-time token savings metrics and CCR cache statistics.
- `squeeze_doctor`: Perform a health diagnostic check on the local compression pipeline.
